# CampusArge

> Global Education Directory & Institutional Comparison Platform

CampusArge is an independent academic discovery platform connecting students, educators, and researchers with 426+ verified universities and institutions worldwide. It provides authentic metrics on tuition costs, acceptance rates, student-faculty ratios, campus housing, academic programs, and accreditation status.

## Primary Sections
- [Home](https://campusarge.com/): Overview, featured global institutions, and academic opportunities.
- [Institutions Directory](https://campusarge.com/institutions): Searchable database of 426+ institutions with real-time filters for country, tuition, type (Public/Private), and degree levels.
- [Institution Comparison](https://campusarge.com/compare): Multi-institution side-by-side comparison across 16 key criteria including Cost of Attendance, Student-to-Faculty Ratio, Housing, and Accreditation.
- [Academic Insights & Blog](https://campusarge.com/blog): Articles on international admissions, research collaborations, and global education trends.
- [About Us](https://campusarge.com/about): Mission, verification methodology, and leadership.
- [Contact](https://campusarge.com/contact): Support, institutional onboarding, and general queries.

## Verified Contacts
